title: Housing Finance Board: Approvals & Delays
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation convened for a meeting to address its agenda.
*   Six items related to housing finance were swiftly approved by a unanimous 7-0 vote.
*   Four additional housing-related items (numbers 7-10) were postponed for future consideration.
*   Following this brief meeting, the Austin City Council resumed its regular session.
